reply_text:
I posted two replies in #coastal-team to Bettina. The first claimed that a recurring Monday post can't be scheduled from here. I hadn't checked that, so I posted a correction. I haven't set up any recurring post.

What I can do: post a "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand for #coastal-team and #coastal-random whenever Bettina asks, starting with Monday 19 Oct. I haven't looked into whether a scheduled job could post to Slack on a timer. Hermes has a cron tool, but I didn't test whether it can deliver to this channel. If Bettina wants the Monday 08:00 post automated, someone needs to confirm that setup.
